patterns: 'Hey @grok' + pick-ONE fork is the meta: RitadeCSB's copy of the $500K 'choose ONE' post went 56.5k → 981.7k overnight, 2.6x the original (379.7k). Fresh copies from small accounts hit 23.9k and 20.6k with under 15 likes each, and a $100K Canadian version hit 15.7k. Opening by tagging @grok seems to be part of why it travels (Grok's public reply becomes the hook). Keywords: Hey @grok, choose ONE, generational wealth, by 55, brutally honest.
Fear questions keep climbing: Cardone's 'Will BTC go to zero? 😬' 117.5k → 131.8k. Short, scared, one line, replies do the work. Keywords: go to zero, crash, 😬.

Contrarian patience: HughInvests' 'S&P took nearly 13 years to recover' grew 72.2k → 85.3k, and Cardone's 'no tenants, termites or toilets' 42.9k → 47.8k. Pushback on the default advice keeps earning replies. Keywords: just buy, nobody tells you, tenants, toilets.

narrative_synthesis: Today's meta: (1) 'Hey @grok' + pick-ONE fork, where a copy beat the original by 2.6x and copies from tiny accounts break 20k, (2) one-line fear questions (131.8k), and (3) contrarian pushback on default advice (85.3k). Drafts: a Philly 'Hey @grok' fork, a Philly fear question, and a 'nobody tells you about the first tenant' honest-landlord prompt.

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, you're 30, you live in Philly, and you have $60k cash.

Choose ONE to build generational wealth by 50:

• Buy a rowhome, fix it up, rent it out
• Learn wholesaling and stack assignment fees
• Put the $60k in an index fund and don't touch it

Be brutally honest. Pick one and say why.
drafts.pattern: 'Hey @grok' + pick-ONE fork: same shape as the 981.7k copy and the 23.9k/20.6k copies (tag @grok + age + cash + three concrete options + 'be brutally honest'), localized to Philly and wholesaling. Asks for opinions, promises no returns.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head, 10–12s. Read it like you're asking Grok out loud, three fingers up, one per option, each option on screen exactly as written. Caption every word. End on 'Be brutally honest' and point at the camera. Pin your own answer as the first reply after people start voting.

drafts.draft_en: Will Philly house prices ever come down? 😬
drafts.pattern: One-line fear question, same shape as 'Will BTC go to zero? 😬' (131.8k). Local, short, and the replies carry it. Makes no prediction.
drafts.video_tip: Optional 6s clip: slow pan down a Philly rowhome block, the question as big centered text, no voiceover. Or post it as text only with one street photo.

drafts.draft_en:
Everyone says "just buy rentals."

Nobody tells you about the first tenant who stops paying, the 2 AM toilet call, or the roof you didn't budget for.

Landlords: what's the one thing you wish someone had told you before your first property?
drafts.pattern: Contrarian pushback on default advice, like HughInvests' 'just buy the S&P 500?' (85.3k) and Cardone's 'tenants, termites, toilets' (47.8k). Ends on an experience question so replies carry it.
drafts.video_tip: Talking head, 15s, walking past rowhomes. Say the three 'nobody tells you' lines with a quick on-screen cut for each (tenant, toilet, roof). Caption everything. End on the question and hold eye contact for 2s.
